intro: A plate of mee hoon goreng is about 450 kcal (estimate). Most of the calories come from the mee hoon and the oil used for frying.

breakdown.part: Egg and a bit of chicken or tauhu

variants.name: Mee hoon goreng with telur mata (fried egg)

diet: Yes, but mee hoon goreng is high in carbs and low in protein. The oil also depends a lot on the stall. Make it a balanced meal by adding protein and vegetables. For something lighter, mee hoon sup is a good choice.
tips: Ask for less oil and more vegetables.
Add a boiled egg or chicken for protein.
Use a smaller plate, or share if you buy a big bungkus.

swap.name: Mee hoon sup with chicken or fish balls
swap.why: Not fried, so less oil, but the hot soup still fills you up.

faq.q: What is mee hoon made of?
faq.a: Mee hoon is made from rice flour. It's naturally gluten-free, but the sauces used might contain gluten.

faq.q: Why does my mee hoon goreng stick together?
faq.a: Usually because it was soaked too long or the wok wasn't hot enough. Soak it just until soft.

faq.q: How long does mee hoon goreng last?
faq.a: Best to finish it within a few hours. If keeping it, put it in the fridge and eat within 1 day.
